# SUPPLEMENTARY 2: COMPARISON OF MUTATION RATES TO INHERITED PREDISPOSITION
This markdown described the construction for comparisons to rates of somatic mutations
inferred from studies of MUTYH and POLE / POLD1 inherited cancer predisposition

## a: estimate rates of mutagenesis in predisposition syndromes:
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
crypt_signature_attributions<-read.csv('../Data/crypt_signature_attributions.csv')
crypt_metadata<-read.csv('../Data/biopsy_metadata.csv')
```

## a : read in the data from MUTYH and DNA Polymerase studies :
```{r}
## load in MUTYH data from Phil Robinson Paper
mutyh_data<-read_excel('../Data/MUTYH_Robinson_Nature_Comms_2022/41467_2022_31341_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx')%>%
  select(sample,patient,age,germline_mutation,type,sbstotal,indeltotal)%>%
   mutate(cohort='MUTYH')%>%
  filter(type=='normal')
colnames(mutyh_data)<-c('sample','individual','age','germline_mutation','sample_type','SBStotal','IDtotal','cohort')

## load in pole data from Phil Robinson Paper
pole_data<-read_excel('../Data/POLE_Robinson_Nature_Genetics_2021/41588_2021_930_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx',sheet=2, skip=2)%>%
  select(sample,individual,age,germline_mutation,sample_type,SBStotal,IDtotal)%>%
  mutate(cohort='Polymerase')%>%
  filter(sample_type=='intestinal crypt')

## determine rates from inherited predispositions :
inherited_predisposition=rbind(pole_data,mutyh_data)%>%
  mutate(IDtotal=as.numeric(IDtotal),SBStotal=as.numeric(SBStotal))%>%
  mutate(germline_mutation=ifelse(germline_mutation %in% c("POLD1 L474P","POLD1 D316N"),'POLD1 L474P/POLD1 D316N',germline_mutation))

inherited_summary_rates<-inherited_predisposition%>%
  group_by(individual)%>%
  mutate(IDtotal=as.numeric(IDtotal),SBStotal=as.numeric(SBStotal))%>%
  summarise(SBSmean=mean(SBStotal,na.rm=T),IDmean=mean(IDtotal,na.rm=T),age=min(age),germline_mutation=first(germline_mutation))
```

## b : create summary for per biopsy of children
```{r}
## cohort summary :
normative_cases<-left_join(crypt_metadata,crypt_signature_attributions,by=c('patient','biopsy'))%>%
  select(crypt,biopsy,patient,age,location,snv_total_burden,indel_total_burden,!contains('sensitivity'),biopsy_colibactin_pos)%>%
  mutate(germline_mutation='Nil',
         SBStotal=rowSums(pick(contains('SBS'))),
         IDtotal=rowSums(pick(contains('ID'))),
         cohort=ifelse(biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE, 'colibactin_positive','background_mutagenesis'))%>%
  select(crypt,biopsy,patient,age,germline_mutation,location,SBStotal,IDtotal,cohort)


normative_cases_sum<-normative_cases%>%
  group_by(biopsy)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(IDtotal_median=median(IDtotal,na.rm=T),
                   IDtotal_lwr=quantile(IDtotal,0.25,na.rm=T),
                   IDtotal_upr=quantile(IDtotal,0.75,na.rm=T),
                   SBStotal_median=median(SBStotal,na.rm=T),
                   SBStotal_lwr=quantile(SBStotal,0.25,na.rm=T),
                   SBStotal_upr=quantile(SBStotal,0.75,na.rm=T),
                   age=median(age),
                   location=first(location),
                   
                   cohort=first(cohort),
                   patient=first(patient))%>%
  mutate(location=ifelse(location=='Sigmoid','Left Sided Colon', 'Right Sided Colon'))

normative_cases_sum$location=factor(normative_cases_sum$location,levels=c('Left Sided Colon', 'Right Sided Colon'))

```

## c : determine rates for germline predisposition individuals :
```{r}
## write a small function to extract labels from functions
extract_background_labels <- function(model) {
  coef_tab <- summary(model)$coefficients
  
  slope     <- coef_tab["age", "Estimate"]
  se        <- coef_tab["age", "Std. Error"]
  slope_low_ci  <- slope - 1.96 * se
  slope_upp_ci <- slope + 1.96 * se
  
  list(
    ci_label = paste0(
      "Background: ", round(slope, 2), " [", round(slope_low_ci, 2), ", ", round(slope_upp_ci, 2), "]"),
    eq_label = paste0(" Background ~ ",round(slope, 2), " * Age"),
    slope=slope,
    slope_low_ci=slope_low_ci,slope_upp_ci=slope_upp_ci
  )
}

background_df <- inherited_predisposition %>%
  filter(!str_detect(germline_mutation,'G286E')) # exclude this case due to only one individuals

## fit regressions for mutation  rates:
sbs_germline_fit_background_model <- function(data) {lmer(SBStotal~ 0 + age + (1 | individual), data = data)}

## construct background models
background_models <- background_df |>
  split(background_df$germline_mutation)  |>
  lapply(sbs_germline_fit_background_model)

sbs_background_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  background_models,
  ~{
    labs <- extract_background_labels(.x)
    tibble(
      germline_mutation = .y,
      ci_label = labs$ci_label,
      eq_label = labs$eq_label,
      slope    = labs$slope,
      slope_low_ci=labs$slope_low_ci,
      slope_upp_ci=labs$slope_upp_ci,
      
    )
  }
)

sbs_germline_background_summary<-sbs_background_summary%>%
  mutate(across(contains('slope'),~round(.x,digits=0)))%>%
  mutate(eq_label=paste0('Background ~ ', slope,' * age'))%>%
  mutate(intercept=0)%>%
  mutate(germline_mutation=case_when(!str_detect(germline_mutation,'POL')~ paste0('MUTYH ',germline_mutation),
                            TRUE~germline_mutation),
         gene_mutated=ifelse(str_detect(germline_mutation,'POL'),'DNA Polymerase','MUTYH'))

sbs_germline_background_summary

## repeat for indels :
id_germline_fit_background_model <- function(data) {lmer(IDtotal~ 0 + age + (1 | individual), data = data)}

background_models <- background_df |>
  split(background_df$germline_mutation)  |>
  lapply(id_germline_fit_background_model)

id_background_summary_germline <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  background_models,
  ~{
    labs <- extract_background_labels(.x)
    tibble(
      germline_mutation = .y,
      ci_label = labs$ci_label,
      eq_label = labs$eq_label,
      slope    = labs$slope,
      slope_low_ci=labs$slope_low_ci,
      slope_upp_ci=labs$slope_upp_ci,
      
    )
  }
)

id_background_summary_germline<-id_background_summary_germline%>%
  mutate(across(contains('slope'),~round(.x,digits=2)))%>%
  mutate(eq_label=paste0('Background ~ ', slope,' * age'))%>%
  mutate(intercept=0)%>%
  mutate(gene=ifelse(str_detect(germline_mutation, 'POL'),'DNA Polymerase','MUTYH'))%>%
  mutate(germline_mutation=case_when(!str_detect(germline_mutation,'POL')~ paste0('MUTYH ',germline_mutation),
                            TRUE~germline_mutation))
```

## b : construct plots for predisposition syndromes
### i : construct plots for DNA Polymerase mutagenesis :
```{r}
polymerase_id_rates<-id_background_summary_germline%>%
  filter(str_detect(germline_mutation,'POL'))
mutyh_id_rates<-id_background_summary_germline%>%
  filter(!str_detect(germline_mutation,'POL'))

# Create a sequence of x (age) values
x_vals <- seq(0, 17, length.out = 100)

# Expand your slope table to have y-values for ribbon
polymerase_id_ribbons <- polymerase_id_rates %>%
  tidyr::expand_grid(age = x_vals) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y = slope * age + intercept, y_min = slope_low_ci * age + intercept, y_max = slope_upp_ci * age + intercept)

mutyh_id_ribbons <- mutyh_id_rates %>%
  tidyr::expand_grid(age = x_vals) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y = slope * age + intercept, y_min = slope_low_ci * age + intercept, y_max = slope_upp_ci * age + intercept)

## plot for ID rates :
png('~/id_inherited_predisp_plots.png',width=1200,height=800,res=100)
ggplot(data=normative_cases_sum[normative_cases_sum$cohort=='colibactin_positive',],aes(x=age,y=IDtotal_median,col=cohort))+
  facet_wrap(~location)+
  geom_abline(data=polymerase_id_rates,aes(slope=slope,intercept=0,linetype=germline_mutation),col='slateblue')+
  geom_abline(data=mutyh_id_rates,aes(slope=slope,intercept=0,linetype=germline_mutation),col='chocolate4')+

  #geom_abline(data=id_background_summary_plot,aes(slope=slope,intercept=0,linetype = "Background ID rate"),colour='grey30')+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = IDtotal_lwr, ymax = IDtotal_upr),width = 0,colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(col='black',size=2) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,17))+
  scale_alpha_discrete(range=c(0.2,0.2))+
  labs(x='Donor Age [years]',y='ID Mutation Burden',linetype='Inherited Germline\nMutation')+
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", colour = "grey20"),
    legend.title=element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.background=element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )
dev.off()
```
